resources.string: Mihon Extension Network Profiles
Tune extension networking without changing the rest of Miyorare.

Mihon-compatible extensions now support Adaptive, Standard, Aggressive, and Custom network profiles. Custom mode can control connection timeout, safe retries, retry delay, temporary-error backoff, and per-source host overrides.
Settings → Storage & Network → Mihon Extensions
Choose Adaptive for the recommended behavior, or use another profile when a specific extension needs faster failure handling or more tolerance.
Source WebView Access
Open a source website when login, cookies, or a browser challenge is needed.

Mihon-compatible sources can now be opened in the internal WebView with the source session context so login and browser challenges can complete without ad-block rules interrupting the authentication flow.
Source → Menu → WebView
Open WebView from the source menu, complete the required login or challenge, then return to Miyorare and retry the source.
Smarter Related Manga
Related titles are grouped into focused, scrollable suggestions.

Related Manga can now use bounded multi-keyword groups with horizontal carousels and Show All actions. Related loading waits until the main Details data is ready, and expanded groups avoid duplicate fallback searches.
Manga Details → Related
Open Related from Manga Details, swipe through each suggestion group, or tap Show All to see more results for that keyword.
Large Library Loading Modes
Choose lighter paging or faster continuous scrolling while keeping memory bounded.

Favourites and Downloaded now offer Paged and Continuous loading modes. Paged uses conservative adaptive batches, while Continuous advances through larger adaptive chunks without materializing the entire library in memory at once.
Settings → Favourites → List loading mode
Keep Paged for the recommended balance. Use Continuous when you prefer faster long-distance scrolling through a very large library while retaining bounded memory use.
One-Tap Chapter Download
Download a chapter directly without an extra action menu.
The chapter download button now starts the normal download flow in one tap. The misleading Start now menu was removed because it did not provide real queue priority.
Manga Details → Chapter → Download
Tap the download icon on a chapter to add it directly to the normal download flow.
Faster Download Queue Feedback
Pause, resume, and cancel actions now show their transition immediately.

Download queue state handling and notifications were refined so queued work reacts more clearly. Empty-state waiting and worker hydration retries were shortened, while frequent notification privacy checks are cached briefly to reduce database churn.
Downloads
Use Pause, Resume, or Cancel normally; Miyorare now shows the transition while the worker finishes applying the requested state.
